newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha contango widens in sloppy prompt market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha contango widens in sloppy prompt market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Tuesday as poor May demand pushed the current May/June contango out further, trader said.
Traders assessed full range cif NWE cargoes around $176/$180 for May delivery and $184/$185 for June.
"The market's looking pretty sloppy in the short-term but further out I'm expecting it to pick-up," said one trader.
"It's interesting to note that sellers aren't offering their cargoes too aggressively. They're nervous about what could happen in July."
Traders said the widening contango on naphtha swaps also revealed the sloppy state of the market.
May paper was quoted around $179/$180 and June paper around $186/$187 in afternoon trade.
